votes.motion: Approve and accept the sewer easements granted by land owners over portions of Lakeview Avenue, Sunset Avenue and Harris Avenue, per the plan dated December 5, 2014.

votes.motion: Approve and sign the Order of Taking by eminent domain of a permanent sewer easement at 40 Lakeview Avenue (112-40), award no damages, and authorize Town Counsel to record it within thirty days.
votes.quote: dave made the motion to accept , butch seconded .

votes.motion: Remove the highlighted SRF-conditional clause from the Pleasant View placeholder and submit the placeholder for the Pleasant View extension only after it has been updated and approved by Carl.
votes.quote: dave made the motion to take out the highlighted section and clarify with c ounsel.

votes.motion: Put the Reserve Capacity Fee Stabilization Fund forward as Article 3 on the Town Meeting warrant.
votes.quote: mike made the motion for article 3, butch seconded.

votes.motion: Update the manhole mapping in town for $1000 (Pat's formal quote).
votes.quote: dave made the motion to update the manhole mapping in town for $1 000, butch seconded.

carl asked for a motion to adjourn. mike made the motion, dave seconded.
